ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant contiguous dark blob occupies the central and medial regions of the fluke. High-intensity, irregular mottling is concentrated at the distal 20% of both the left and right lobes. A single, high-contrast vertical linear feature is located at the lower-left boundary of the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A well-defined V-shaped central notch with a depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring variable pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) that increase in irregularity toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A consistent concave upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal lobe tips along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Rough-textured, high-contrast dark clusters (barnacle colonization) are clearly localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned vertical white linear pixel disruption is visible on the lower-left ventral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white vertical scar on the left lobe and dense barnacle clusters at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pattern of 'frosted' white pigmentation localized exclusively at the distal edges of the lobes.
